title: Tabs and tiles hold still when pressed
body: Two tabs, then two pinned tiles, pressed in the sidebar. nightly.6 squished each one and bounced it back. Now they stay put; the hover highlight still fades.

title: A pressed tab, slowed down
body: The first press again at a quarter of the speed. In nightly.6 the row shrinks under the pointer and springs back. Now it doesn't move.

title: A pressed tile, slowed down
body: A pinned tile at a quarter of the speed. nightly.6 shrank the tile and its icon. Now the tile holds its size.

title: Folders open without a jolt
body: Two folders opened and closed. In nightly.6 the folder icon slid sideways and sprang back on every click. Now it stays where it is.

title: Opening a folder, slowed down
body: The first click at a quarter of the speed. Watch the folder icon: it jumps right and back in nightly.6, and holds still now.

title: Folders look like folders again
body: A folder with no colour of its own and a live folder of pull requests. nightly.6 drew a plain outline and the GitHub icon. Now both get the tinted folder from nightly.5.

title: The ardia command is now a plugin
body: Settings › Plugins, then Advanced. nightly.6 listed no plugins and kept an on/off switch for the ardia command. Now Command Line is under Plugins, and Advanced says whether it's installed, with a link to Plugins.

title: Little Ardia follows the switcher setting
body: Two profiles, with Switcher in the sidebar shows set to Nothing. nightly.6 still drew the profile button in Little Ardia's bar. Now it's hidden there too; ⌃1 to ⌃9 still switch.
